name: 51103 · Sioux City, IA
findings: ZIP 51103 (Sioux City) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 51103 (Sioux City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 51103 (Sioux City) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 51103 (Sioux City) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).
